title: Source Hydrator: Applications hydrating into the repository root stop working

detection.reason: hydratorPath is projected as the Application's spec.sourceHydrator.syncSource.path, and as an empty string when the hydrator is configured without a path

quote: Source hydration (with Source Hydrator) now requires that every application specify a non-root path. Using the repository root (for example, "" or ".") is no longer supported.
remediation: Set `spec.sourceHydrator.syncSource.path` to a subdirectory (for example `apps/guestbook`) on each Application named here before upgrading, then delete stale hydration output left at the repository root.
verifyCommand: kubectl get applications -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.sourceHydrator != null) | select((.spec.sourceHydrator.syncSource.path // "") | test("^[./]*$")) | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name' # names printed hydrate into the repository root

title: `.argocd-source.yaml` can now pin the Kustomize version

detection.reason: `.argocd-source.yaml` lives in the repository, not on the cluster

quote: Starting with Argo CD v3.2, you can now set the Kustomize version in the `.argocd-source.yaml` file like this:
remediation: If a repository already carries `kustomize.version` in `.argocd-source.yaml`, it now takes effect — make sure that version is registered under `kustomize.versions` in argocd-cm, or rendering fails.

title: CronJobs now carry health — Applications may turn Degraded

detection.reason: which CronJobs an Application manages is not related in the inventory; the hint names CronJobs that carry the Argo CD tracking annotation

quote: After the upgrade, Application's status may transition to `Degraded` depending on the CronJob health.
remediation: Decide per CronJob: accept the new health, override it via `resource.customizations.health.batch_CronJob` in argocd-cm, or annotate the CronJob `argocd.argoproj.io/ignore-healthcheck: "true"` to keep it out of the Application's aggregated health.
verifyCommand: kubectl get cronjobs -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.annotations["argocd.argoproj.io/tracking-id"] != null or .metadata.labels["app.kubernetes.io/instance"] != null) | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name' # CronJobs printed are Argo CD managed and start contributing health at 3.2

title: ApplicationSet `status.resources` is capped at 5000 entries

detection.reason: the size of an ApplicationSet's status.resources list is not projected

quote: The `resources` field of the `status` resource of an ApplicationSet is now limited to 5000 elements by default. This is to prevent status bloat and exceeding etcd limits.
remediation: If an ApplicationSet generates more than 5000 Applications and your tooling reads `status.resources`, raise `applicationsetcontroller.status.max.resources.count` in argocd-cmd-params-cm or read the Applications directly.
verifyCommand: kubectl get applicationsets -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.status.resources[4999] != null) | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name' # names printed already exceed 5000 generated Applications
